d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, chatpata lehsun wala aam achar banane ki recipe share kar raha hu, ye Andhra Style se inspired hai, proper avakai ki recipe nahi hai, humari ghar ki style ki mango garlic Pickle hai, aap try karna, khatarnaak tasty banta hai, chahe aap chawal ke saath khao ya roti ke saath :)
Recipe:
Raw Mango - 10 pcs or 2kg weight
After Cutting & removing pit/seed Mango - 1500-1600g
Peeled Garlic - 500gram Total
Make Paste of 270-280g Garlic
Cut Garlic into 2-3 pieces - 220-230g
For pickle masala mix
